# StudyFlow — Academic Command Center
> An institutional-grade academic operating system for university scholars and engineering students.

## Architecture
- Framework: Vite 8.3 + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 3.4
- State: Zustand with local persistence and Firestore multi-tenant synchronization
- Routing: Semantic HTML5 History pushState / popstate deep linking
- Features: Coursework registry, interactive calendar timetable, Pomodoro focus timer with ambient soundscapes, GPA & grade predictor, local/cloud disaster recovery backup

## Routes
- `/`: Academic command ledger & daily briefings
- `/assignments`: Deliverables registry with filtering, search, and pagination
- `/calendar`: 7-day timetable with interactive weekly navigation & .ics export
- `/timer`: Zero-drift Pomodoro focus timer with Web Audio soundscapes
- `/grades`: Real-time cumulative GPA calculator & final exam grade simulator
